[[File:Annamar.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The planetoid [[Annamar]]]]
A '''planetoid''' was an astronomical object in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around a [[Star/Legends|star]]. Planetoids were classified as being smaller than standard-sized [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but larger than [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Depending on their size and density, they often had surfaces capable of sustaining [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life.

{{Science-stub}}
